name: Nottingham
source:
“Fufu, I just wanted to say that.
I believe I can make things easier for you.
So please, don't overexert yourself.”

Unit: Security Blue, 1st Squad
Rank: Address

A squad leader who is currently missing.

Ambitious and hungry for prestige, he believes that someone of his noble standing is the one who ought to accomplish everything.

Because of his connections within the Provisional Committee, the secretive group of people that oversees H.A.Z.E., he managed to obtain command of the 1st Squad—authority that should originally have belonged to Alhena.
